| `stop() → Promise<{ code: 0, signal: null }>` | idempotent: every call returns the same promise, `SIGTERM` is sent once. If the process is running: `signalGroup(pid, "SIGTERM")` (the **group**), wait for the end of the process at most `stopTimeoutMs`; on timeout `SIGKILL` to the group, wait, clean up, throw `STAND_STOP_TIMEOUT`: `<name> did not stop in <ms> ms after SIGTERM; it was killed`. After the process has ended: `SIGKILL` to the group for anything it left behind, wait (3 s) for the group to be gone, `unregisterGroup`, remove the marker (the registration and the marker are removed also when the group is still alive). **Precedence (N11):** if the group is still there after the wait, `CLEANUP_FAILED` is thrown and it **wins** over `STAND_EXIT` (a process left alive is the graver fact); its message ends with the exit code or signal of the main process. Only when the group is gone: if the exit was not code 0 with no signal → `STAND_EXIT`: `<name> ended with exit code <n>|signal <s>` (+ ` after SIGTERM` or ` on its own`) + `. Last line of its stderr: "<line>"`. A process that ended by itself before `stop()` is cleaned up the same way and `stop()` then throws `STAND_EXIT` (a crashed server fails the test that used it) |
